objective: Send one existing verified file-delivery handoff to one mailbox through TLS SMTP with contact aliases, durable no-resend-on-unknown semantics and safe CLI. Offline qualification is not live channel receipt.

acceptance.behavior: Implement notification.send(state_dir,delivery_key,smtp_config,recipient,notification_key,*,contacts_path=None,transport=None,checkpoint=None), notification.status(state_dir,notification_key), contacts.resolve(recipient,contacts_path=None). CLI send-email --state-dir DIR --delivery-key KEY --smtp-config FILE --to RECIPIENT --key KEY [--contacts FILE] --json; status-email --state-dir DIR --key KEY --json. Standard library only for notification; preserve existing behavior and dependencies. Success one JSON object schema_version1,status=channel-accepted,notification_id,key,delivery_task_id,message_id,reused,receipt_status=unverified,read_status=unverified. Structured errors exit2. No packaging, upload, signing, URL renewal, attachment, CC/BCC or template customization in this task.

Contacts JSON exact schema {schema_version:1,contacts:{alias:addr_spec}}; aliases Unicode exact/case-sensitive/nonempty, single target strings; reject duplicate keys, malformed shapes and unknown fields as CONTACTS_INVALID. No recursion. Direct ASCII addr-spec bypasses contacts file; unknown alias CONTACT_NOT_FOUND. Validate entire single address, never parse a substring: local part dot-atom <=64 characters with no leading/trailing/consecutive dot, domain ASCII DNS labels with no leading/trailing hyphen, no empty labels, entire address<=254. Preserve local case/lowercase domain. Reject controls including CR LF NUL DEL, whitespace, display names, angle brackets, comma/semicolon, quoted local parts, non-ASCII mailbox. User invalid mailbox=>RECIPIENT_INVALID; invalid config sender=>CONFIG_INVALID. Reject address/header injection before any transport call. Alias inputs/keys must not contain ASCII controls. Alias without contacts_path=>CONTACTS_INVALID; alias absent from a valid contacts file=>CONTACT_NOT_FOUND.

SMTP config exact JSON fields schema_version=1,host,port,tls,username,password_file,from_address,timeout_seconds. Host nonempty DNS hostname/IP without controls/whitespace/URL; port integer1..65535, timeout finite numeric1..60, booleans invalid, tls implicit or starttls, username nonempty with no controls. Password file UTF8 nonempty; remove at most one terminal LF or CRLF, preserve other spaces. Relative password_file resolves against config parent. Config/contacts/password files real owner-private regular files0600 or stricter, no lexical symlink components. Invalid config or password=>CONFIG_INVALID, contacts=>CONTACTS_INVALID. Production notification.SmtpTransport.prepare(config,from_addr,to_addr) connects, verifies certificate+hostname with ssl.create_default_context, performs EHLO, required STARTTLS then EHLO when selected, login, MAIL FROM and RCPT TO, but never DATA. prepare receives validated in-memory config including password. submit(message,from_addr,to_addr) accepts EmailMessage, sends DATA only and returns {status:channel-accepted,smtp_code:<final2xx>} only on positive final reply; all negative/ambiguous submit responses raise or fail safely. close() best effort. No plaintext TLS fallback/debug logging. Injectable transport API-only; config validation identical even when injected.

Use accepted FD004B private handoff read-only, no Qiniu calls. New notification requires remote task state link-verified; revoking/object-deleted/other states=>DELIVERY_NOT_READY. Existing read-only remote helper or equivalent notification logic allowed. Validate task_id,object_key,archive_sha256,archive_size,expires_at,password_file and URL digest against remote DB. URL must match recorded digest; expiration integer currenttime<expires_at or LINK_EXPIRED. Expected handoff directory remote-handoffs/task_id.json and expected password path remote-bundles/task_id/password.txt; validate private owner permissions and every lexical path component before reading. Reject substituted paths/symlinks/tampered fields/DB or missing secrets with STATE_INVALID; no following arbitrary password_file. Fixed text EmailMessage with one From/To, stable persisted Message-ID, subject fixed product prefix plus notification_id, body contains URL,password,archive_size,expires_at, no attachments. Body/secrets in memory only, URL remains only existing protected handoff and password only existing bundle file at rest. Before a new submission validate the existing bundle with archive.verify so a changed password or corrupted encrypted archive cannot be mailed as usable; verification failure=>STATE_INVALID with no SMTP preparation. This is read-only and does not repackage.

Use separate notifications.sqlite3 and private locks in state dir, no changes to remote lifecycle. State private directory0700/current owner, DB/locks0600; reject lexical symlinks, wrong ownership or group/other permissions as STATE_INVALID. Notification keys existing safe regex. Persist notification id and stable message id before network. Fingerprint binds source delivery key/task_id/archive hash/handoff identity digest, canonical recipient, sender, normalized host/port/TLS/username; excludes secret bytes/password-file location. Same alias target/direct mailbox equivalent; retarget alias or changed recipient/source/destination=>IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Same-key accepted returns stored channel acceptance,reused=true with zero transport calls even after source expires; status is persisted history not refreshed availability. Unknown/sending prior result never sends again. Password rotation alone permits explicit safe prepared retry. Serialize same key with OS lock <=5second deadline. Status offline requires no config/remote input/network and returns safe state,metadata,last_error,retryable,receipt/read unverified, never secret body/URL/password/SMTP credentials. Secrets and raw external errors must not enter DB/stdout/status/logs; recipient routing metadata may be stored in private DB.

States prepared,sending,channel-accepted,failed-before-send,unknown. prepare exceptions before any DATA persist failed-before-send with safe SMTP_CONNECT/SMTP_TLS/SMTP_AUTH/SMTP_REJECTED or SMTP_PREPARE and retryable=true; no automatic retries, later explicit matching send may retry. Commit sending before submit, checkpoint(before_submit) after commit. submit any exception/nonpositive/malformed result or interruption leaves unknown/no retry; record SMTP_UNKNOWN and retryable=false. checkpoint(after_submit) runs after positive final DATA but before accepted commit; death/error/DB commit failure there must not permit same-key resubmission. Positive accepted persisted then close/quit error preserves accepted. Recover prior sending as unknown, never resubmit. Both real process exit checkpoints must be tested; before_submit crash conservatively unknown even when no actual DATA. Returned accepted does not claim receipt/read. Callback exceptions sanitized. Before the durable sending boundary classify known SMTP/SSL exceptions first into the safe SMTP vocabulary; otherwise an ordinary unclassified OSError maps IO_ERROR with failed-before-send/retryable=true; unknown authority wins over ordinary IO errors once submission may have begun.

Stable sanitized errors, no arbitrary provider text or traceback. Normalize injected error codes to controlled vocabulary. Unknown task TASK_NOT_FOUND, corrupt notification or required remote DB STATE_INVALID, invalid key INVALID_KEY, BUSY bounded. CLI statuses reflect same API and remain offline; missing private files must fail before prepare. Tests include actual fork/exit, concurrency, samekey unknown nonresend, TLS mocks, address injection, private handoff tamper, revoked/expired rejection and secret rotation. All service data synthetic and no real SMTP/Qiniu operations; this delivers offline-qualified implementation only, real channel acceptance pending explicit config/recipient/authority. Preserve all old controller/Worker suites without weakening tests.
